t.E470b.agn: In 2018 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported uses and use levels.
t.E470b.body: In the body it breaks down into fatty acids and the corresponding mineral; the fatty acids are used like the fats in foods.
t.E470b.eval: The fatty acid source may be vegetable or animal (including beef/pork); the source is often not stated on the label.
t.E470b.prod: It is obtained by breaking down vegetable or animal fats through a chemical process.
t.E470b.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern.
t.E470b.summary: Magnesium salt of fatty acids (magnesium stearate, etc.). It prevents caking in tablets and powdered products; the fat source may be vegetable or animal.
t.E470b.what: It is used as an anti-caking agent and release agent, and also as an emulsifier.
